simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֲרָבוֹן (H6162) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: עֲרָבוֹן (ʻărâbôwn) means a pawn (given as security) First listed occurrence: Gen 38 17.

definitions.full: H6162. erabon עֵרָבוֺן noun [masculine] pledge ; — ע ׳נָתַן give a pledge Gen 38:17-18 , ע ׳לָקַח 38:20 (all J), receive (back) a pledge (when condition is fulfilled). — Job 17:3 read perhaps עֶרְבֹנִי (for עָרְבֵנִי ᵑ0 ), as object of שֹׂימָה set my pledge (a surety for me) , so Beer Bu and others
